Name: Agent Deck
Author: mtaro346
Description: Control and monitor your agent-deck AI coding sessions from Stream Deck +, XL, and other models. Each key shows a session with live status; press to open its live web terminal. The dial scrolls sessions on Stream Deck +.

Actions.Name: Agent Session
Actions.Tooltip: Shows an agent-deck session with live status. Press to open its live terminal (or run start/stop/restart).

Actions.Name: Session Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate to scroll agent-deck sessions; press or tap to open the selected session (Stream Deck +).
